computational_boundary.expanded_vs_compact: Implicit lossless family and exact query answers may replace expanded hypothesis arrays without changing the scientific retained set; unavailable quantities cannot be approximated or represented as empty.
computational_boundary.scope: Limits are computational metadata, not extra arms or scientific retention cutoffs. This definition manifest does not authorize a runtime policy or execution. The existing historical full runner still uses old enumeration; corrected integration must preserve all metrics through exact queries and emit explicit failures if bounded computation cannot complete.

order: Representation outermost, width middle, association innermost; exact original ordering.

association_shared.cost: Sum over forward edges of ((f_next-f_previous)/50)^2 + 0.25 when fragment increment is 2.
association_shared.denominator: All original episode fragments, including empty/unusable fragments; never eligible-only denominator.
association_shared.objective: Lexicographic: maximize sum(len(path)-1), then minimize cost; retain all max-link partitions accepted by frozen margin predicates.
association_shared.partition: Candidate-disjoint unordered partitions; each eligible candidate exactly once; singleton zero links and zero cost; do not count path-label or ordering permutations.
association_shared.preferences: No amplitude, DoA, source label, expected frequency, diagnostic region, or cross-episode identity preference.
association_shared.primary: Path arm: unique possible persistent path across the union, invariant in every retained hypothesis; no other possible persistent path. Connected uses its distinct unchanged recurring-competitor veto.

associations.computational_mapping: Unchanged historical connected selection through staged integration.
associations.semantics: Undirected connected components over eligible candidate edges with fragment increment 1/2 and step <=50 Hz. Coherent only with at most one member per fragment and range <=100 Hz. Persistent support >=3 and coverage >=0.6. Primary only one persistent group and no recurring coherent competitor or incoherent group with support >=2. No path partition or margin; hypothesis fields null.

associations.computational_mapping: Exact implicit EpisodeFamily + structural/certificate-dispatched V3 short-path/matching-polynomial, V2/dyadic/monotone binary64 and E05 cutoff composition; candidate-cover exact query engine. Margin0 V3 certificate rejects to fallback. No capture/episode/arm-ID selection of count routes.
associations.semantics: Partition every eligible candidate exactly once into candidate-disjoint forward paths, including explicit singletons; maximize continuation links, then minimize frozen binary64 cost; retain all maximum-link partitions within the margin under the original local and episode prefix predicates. Primary requires exactly one possible persistent path, invariant in every retained partition.

scientific_configuration.candidate_identity: E{episode:03d}_F{fragment:03d}_C{component_index:04d}; component index is frequency-ordered retained detector run before width filtering; scope by capture/episode/representation. Width rejection never renumbers/deletes components. Equal-frequency candidates with distinct IDs stay distinct; do not match candidates across representations by coincident ID alone.

detector.background: Same-sign eligible bins whose discrete-bin distance is 50..500 Hz inclusive; >=32 bins; positive finite median; no wrapping.
detector.components: Contiguous eligible, defined positive-power bins at contrast >=6 dB; retain runs with maximum contrast >=10 dB; peak is largest envelope power bin, lower-frequency tie. Guard-touching and background-unestimable neighbours cause ineligibility. Full bin intervals define width. Multiple maxima flag alone does not exclude.

frozen_draft1_parameters.primary_selection: unique persistent track; no recurring competitor or ambiguous group

detector.original_spectrum: Read saved Draft1 spectra only: fs=25000 Hz, N-point Hann-window FFT, no zero padding, power abs(FFT)^2/(N*sum(window^2)); do not recapture/recompute IQ to redefine inputs.
detector.width_override: maximum_component_width_hz=200 is baseline only; Draft2 removes that flag and reapplies the arm width. Unlimited is null, never a substitute numerical ceiling.

gates.correct_recovery: Original evaluate_gates requires correct_primary_count strictly greater than connected. Specification mentions improvement or fewer unjustified vetoes; do not silently substitute a new gate for the committed implementation.
gates.incomplete: Gates not evaluable for incomplete experiment; no selected winner.

grid.component_power: Always integrate original unsmoothed native-bin density over detected intervals; retain native plateau maxima once.
grid.rebin: Treat native power as uniform density on 25000/N-Hz periodic bin intervals; split Nyquist crossings; exact interval-overlap integration; conserve total rebinned power; divide by 2.5 Hz for PSD.
grid.smoothing: Normalized discrete Gaussian sampled every 2.5 Hz, offsets inclusive through +/-4 sigma, convolution same with zero extension; endpoint power loss is allowed only from smoothing.

numerical_policy.exact_optimization: Rational/dyadic/integer methods only with rigorous certificates/bounds preserving the binary64 predicate. No rounding, binning, single-real-inequality replacement or hypothesis truncation.
numerical_policy.input_and_cost_arithmetic: Binary64 frequency values and edge coefficients; original path forward sum, local optimum right fold in earliest-candidate partition order, emitted costs left fold, local remaining-budget subtraction/prefix pruning and ordered connected-factor episode prefix pruning.
numerical_policy.tolerance_scope: Cost comparisons only; no frequency tolerance.

original_run_order: real matrix: representation outer, width middle, association inner; frozen capture/episode order
